ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Online contract course (using WebCT/Compass) for FCAE teachers only. Special permission required through Heather Miller at 217-265-6568 or hmiller1@uiuc.edu to enroll. Course materials will be purchased through ITCS directly by the student through ITCS- 1-800-345-6087or at www.ACESPUBS@uiuc.edu $104.50 each set of manuals or the set of CD-roms and manuals for $159. Student must have a set of manuals that is dated 2000 or newer to participate in the course.
